tools.name: list_rental_companies
tools.description: Car rental companies that use Bota and rent directly through it. Returns id, name, website, active channels, whether bookings can be completed here (booking_via_agents) and whether it is the demo company.

tools.name: list_offices
tools.description: Rental offices (pickup/return locations) of a company: name, city, address, opening hours, timezone, coordinates.

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Search available vehicles with real prices for a company, office and dates. Prices are identical to the company's own web chat (mandatory charges, one-way and time rules included). Returns numbered offers and the session_id of this booking session.

tools.name: ask_company
tools.description: Ask the company a free-text question (requirements, deposit, insurance, documents, opening hours, pickup instructions…). Bota answers in the customer's language with the company's approved information. Read-only: it never starts, changes or completes a booking.

tools.name: select_offer
tools.description: Selects one of the numbered offers of the booking session. Returns the extras available for it, or the driver details the company needs. Only for companies with booking_via_agents=true.

tools.name: select_extras
tools.description: Adds optional extras (child seat, additional driver, coverage…) to the booking in progress by extra id; an empty list continues without extras. Only for companies with booking_via_agents=true.

tools.name: provide_customer_details
tools.description: Submits the driver's details for the booking in progress and returns the booking summary with its confirmation_token. terms_accepted records that the customer accepted the company's terms and must be true.

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Confirms the summarised booking with its confirmation_token, which proves the customer saw that exact summary. Creates the reservation in the company's reservation system and returns the confirmation code (and a payment link when the company requires prepayment). An on-request booking comes back pen

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Look up a booking made through Bota: status (confirmed, cancelled…), vehicle, office, dates and total. Needs the booking reference and the email it was made with.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking made through Bota. Without confirm it only returns the booking and whether it can be cancelled; with confirm=true it cancels it. Cancellation fees, if any, follow the company's terms.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_availability, get_booking_status · Private data: ask_company, provide_customer_details · Public sink: get_booking_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_availability, get_booking_status · Private data: ask_company, provide_customer_details · Public sink: get_booking_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_rental_companies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the car-rental companies that sell through Bota. Returns id, name, website, active channels, whether bookings can be completed from this server (booking_via_agents) and whether it is the demo company. Start here." → after: "Car rental companies that use Bota and rent directly through it. Returns id, name, website, active channels, whether bookings can be completed here (booking_via_agents) and whether it is the demo company."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
